repos.name: agent-world
repos.desc: Pixel-art world where my repos' agents live and work, driven by real activity

commits.msg: Review fixes: astronauts are rebuilt once per frame while a colour is dragged, one helper for the card's grid of figures
commits.author: venturinodino-creator

commits.msg: Stuck and expected finish: a run past twice its usual time turns amber and past three times red (only for tasks with three finished runs to compare with) on the astronaut's bar, the card, the drawer and the Overview's attention list; a running task shows when it should finish. Also fixes the card's figures: the next-run line had split an if/else so workflows without one showed commit figures; what the grid shows is now one tested function.
commits.author: venturinodino-creator

commits.msg: Custom colours: the card's Colours section sets an astronaut's suit and helmet separately from twelve swatches or any colour, with a reset and apply-to-all on the island; the astronaut changes at once, the choice is kept in this browser only, invalid colours are ignored, and a disabled task stays grey
commits.author: venturinodino-creator

commits.msg: Review fixes: the drawer keeps its scroll position when redrawn, one status word for a task in the card and the drawer
commits.author: venturinodino-creator

commits.msg: Details drawer: a task's card opens a drawer with Overview, Progress and History tabs built from the task's own data (schedule, next run, current step, last result and duration, run link, the live bar, estimated finish or taking longer than usual, recent runs); it follows the selected task, closes with its button or Escape, and is a sheet on a narrow screen. Time words move to one shared module.
commits.author: venturinodino-creator

commits.msg: Schedule and next run: a task that is not working says when it runs next in the viewer's own time, read from its workflow's schedule (lists, ranges, steps, names); unreadable or never-happening schedules say unknown, none says it runs when started, disabled says so
commits.author: venturinodino-creator

commits.msg: Review fixes: declare the progress second before use, no floating bar for a queued task, district colour comment matches the rings
commits.author: venturinodino-creator

commits.msg: Districts: a CRM's tasks stand together by kind of job (news, contacts, competitors, research, reports, other), read from the words of the task name, each with its own ring colour under its astronauts, and the card names the district
commits.author: venturinodino-creator

commits.msg: Progress bars: a working task shows a bar and percentage over its astronaut and on its card, exact from its steps or an estimate marked with a ≈ from its past runs, held at 95 until the run ends, none when there is nothing to base one on; a stopped run keeps the figure it reached
commits.author: venturinodino-creator

commits.msg: Demo feed: one helper for the hour offsets (review cleanup)
commits.author: venturinodino-creator

commits.msg: Task astronauts on the CRM islands, from a demo feed: ?demo=tasks fills the NL, DK and BE islands with fifteen invented tasks each beside the website astronaut (working, queued, asleep, failing, disabled and greyed, never run); a label says they are invented and a demo task can never be started; without the option the page is unchanged
commits.author: venturinodino-creator

commits.msg: One safe place for personal choices: effects and feed choices move onto a helper that never fails when storage is blocked, ignores damaged values and keeps the saved names and plain text of earlier visits
commits.author: venturinodino-creator

commits.msg: Plan docs for the task-agents upgrade: ADR 0002 (private CRM tasks are read through the server function) and the glossary terms Task, Progress, Analytics, District, Stuck, Wake several, Personal choice, Custom colour
commits.author: venturinodino-creator
